blind.description: A stylized wooden post or bollard with a square cross-section, a faceted pyramidal top, and a dark grey metal collar/strap wrapped around just beneath the cap. The texture is hand-painted stylized wood grain in warm amber-brown tones. All surfaces are solid, continuous, and manifold with clean geometry.
blind.from_above: A small square with an X-shaped seam pattern pointing to the pyramidal apex in the center, casting a long rectangular shadow to the upper-left.
blind.height_vs_figure: About half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 3 to 3.5 feet tall) and about one-quarter to one-third of its diameter in width.
